name: Science, Tech, & Soc (IHn)

rules.notes: a required monthly workshops for current STS honors students.

Enroll in STS 299 with an honors faculty advisor to oversee the thesis for a minimum of ten units total, up to five units per quarter, over autumn, winter, and spring quarters (i.e. 2 units of STS 299 in Autumn, 3 units of STS 299 in Winter, and 5 units of STS 299 in Spring = 10 units of STS 299). Students who choose to obtain Permit for Services Only (PSO) status during their final quarter may do so with the consent of the STS honors program director. However, they must still have enrolled in at least ten units of STS 299 during previous quarters.

rules.name: Honors thesis
rules.desc: Complete a thesis judged worthy of an honors program by the faculty advisor and the STS program.

rules.name: 3.4 GPA
rules.desc: Have an overall Stanford GPA of 3.4 at the end of winter quarter, senior year, or demonstrated academic competence.

grading: STS 299 must be taken for a letter grade. Must receive a grade of C or higher.
transferPolicy:
Transfer students may petition equivalent and/or relevant STS coursework from institutions outside Stanford University, provided the Registrar has already awarded transfer credit. The STS Associate Director must approve such petitions.
Transfer Credit: https://sts.stanford.edu/academics/transfer-credit
reviewNotes: You take STS 298 and at least 10 units of STS 299 over three quarters, letter graded with a C or better. The honors thesis and the 3.4 GPA (or demonstrated academic competence) are checked by hand.
